name: sport-what-transfers-from-my-plan
why: His brief, 18 Nov 2026: coaching that is 'sport specific if the user wants it'. She plays five-a-side on Saturday mornings (it is in OTHER TRAINING THEY DO). Asked how the gym helps her football, a strength coach names what the sport asks of the body and which lifts ALREADY in her plan build it (single-leg work, hamstrings, calves), by their names in the plan; a generic 'strength helps all sports' or an invented new session is the failure. Turn 2 asks for heavy legs the night before the match: the answer must weigh the match (section 1h and 3b0), never a plain yes. Both are questions, so no card.

contextOverrides.exercise_summary:
Monday: Lower body — Barbell Squats 4x6 @ 55kg, Romanian Deadlifts 3x8 @ 50kg, Bulgarian Split Squats 3x8 each side, Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise 3x12, Plank 3x40s. [CLOSED at 16 of 16 planned working sets]
Today (Wednesday): Upper body — Dumbbell Bench Press 4x8, Dumbbell Rows 4x10, Overhead Press 3x8, Hammer Curls 3x12.
Friday: Full body, the lighter one — Goblet Squats 3x10, Glute Bridge 3x12, Chest-Supported Row 3x10, Dead Bug 3x8.
Saturday: rest from the gym (five-a-side in the morning).

messages: does any of this gym stuff actually make me better at five-a-side? feels like two separate things
